issues.title: POLISH — DOUBLE DRAGON: a walked-away friend hands the blue seat back to the CPU (#2908/#2930)
issues.body: Spec = Jon's answers on #2908 and #2930 (answered 2026-11-22):

issues.title: QA — CONTRA: polish pass (voice orders, #3000)
issues.body: QA polish pass for the voice stage shipped in #3000 / main `8c87a00` (issue #3000). Builder lane hands this to QA per the lane split.

issues.title: qa(contra): trainable-adapter polish pass
issues.body: 8b polish pass for the Contra trainable adapter (shipped in #2969 / main `9838eab`). Builder lane hands this to QA per the lane split (#1712 stage notes).

issues.title: Routine: weekly npm audit → patch/minor-only dependency PR
issues.body: **Goal:** keep dependency advisories at zero as routine maintenance, so they never pile up again.

issues.title: never-dry kick lands unactionable when the weakest pick scores from QA feedback only
issues.body: **Evidence — slot b session, 2026-11-22 ~02:00Z:**

issues.title: Consent gate: a "What's this?" link to /retrogames/join
issues.body: The "RECORD THIS PLAYER?" screen (ConsentGate) asks a friend to switch on their mic but never says what it's for. Add a small **"What's this?"** link on it that opens https://jalfern.com/retrogames/join, the friends' how-to (#2824). It should open in a new tab so the gate and the run aren't lost.

issues.title: Gate the nightly-bot roster sync at PR time (class #1350/#1525/#2000/#2804)
issues.body: **Class:** nightly roster drift reddens main — fix is a 1-line CI change.

issues.title: warden: reap the slot's process group, not just opencode (children outlived session 348→349 fork on slot a)
issues.body: ## Symptom

issues.title: NATIVE: drift guard — flag when a native port falls behind its web game
issues.body: The native ports (#2402) copy their web game line for line. Nothing notices when the web side moves on: Emberwood's native renderer is a port of `render.js` (#2439), and #2440 changes `render.js`.
